name: filetree-local
description: IDE-style file tree pane for Claude Code, local build

start.title: Open at start
start.description: on: the pane opens when a session starts. off: it stays closed until you run /filetree.

activity.title: Claude activity
activity.description: Which of Claude's file activity glows in the tree: files read with Read, Grep or Glob in purple; files written with Edit, Write, NotebookEdit or a shell command in orange; files Claude committed or staged in green.

follow.title: Follow Claude
follow.description: on: the tree scrolls to what Claude reads or writes and stays there. off: the view stays where you put it; highlights still show.

refresh.title: Auto refresh
refresh.description: How often the tree and git status are read again while the pane shows, so changes made outside this session appear (another session, an editor, a terminal). off: only on focus, ↻ and Claude's own work. Commits and staging in the session's repository show within a second either way.

hints.title: Hints
hints.description: on: outside a git repo, a line under the header says git status starts after git init. off: the line is hidden and the tree gets the row.
